name: cheerwin-portfolio
description: Cheerwin Chandra's portfolio with a secure contact inbox, ready for Netlify + Neon Postgres.

scripts.prebuild:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=['lib/app.js','netlify/functions/api.mjs','public/index.html','scripts/build-html.mjs'].filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(m.length){console.error('

Upload the folders lib, netlify, public and scripts themselves, not only the files inside them. See README, Step 1.
');process.exit(1)}"
